shortDescription: Creates a certificate signed by a ca and tests validity of certificate

options.name: SANs
options.description: List of SANs Values must be prefixed with type name 'TYPE:value'. Example 'DNS:example.com' Valid types: DNS, IP, email, URI

options.name: archive_dir_path
options.description: Path on ca_host to the certificate archive directory File name is the serial number of the certificate

options.name: archive_path
options.description: Path on ca_host to the certificate file

options.name: assert
options.description: Enable/disable assertions

options.name: ca
options.description: CA Certificate options

options.name: ca_cert_path
options.description: Remote path to the ca certificate file

options.name: ca_config_path
options.description: Path to the ca configuration file which gets generated by the 'generate-ca.py' script

options.name: ca_host
options.description: Host on which the certification signing should happen

options.name: ca_host_options
options.description: Options that should be passed to tasks running on the ca host

options.name: cert_mode
options.description: Remote certificate file mode

options.name: cert_path
options.description: Remote path to the certificate file

options.name: enable_cert_creation
options.description: Enable certificate creation

options.name: force
options.description: Always generate the certificate

options.name: fullchain_cert_path
options.description: Remote path to the full chain certificate file

options.name: private_key_length
options.description: private key length

options.name: private_key_mode
options.description: Private key file mode

options.name: private_key_path
options.description: Remote path to the certificate key file

options.name: private_key_type
options.description: Remote private key type

options.name: profile
options.description: Select profile in profiles list

options.name: profiles
options.description: Profiles define various parameters required for the certificate generation When C(ca_config_path) is set and contains profiles they get merged, preferring the ca config profiles

options.name: select_crypto_backend
options.description: Determines which crypto backend to use.

options.name: subject
options.description: Subject of certificate
